title: Language structure as training for executive functions
title_zh: 语言结构作为执行功能的训练
abstract: Language plays a central role in the development of executive functions (EFs). This forum article discusses how language, as a structured environmental stimulus, can shape EF systems and impact EF outcomes. This has implications for developmental and clinical conditions in which language and EFs are jointly affected, and for congenitally deaf children and adults, who often experience reduced access to natural language during development.
abstract_zh: 语言在执行功能（EF）发展中起着核心作用。本文讨论了语言作为一种结构化的环境刺激，如何塑造EF系统并影响EF结果。这对语言和EF共同受影响的发育与临床状况，以及在发育期间常缺乏自然语言接触的先天性聋人儿童和成人具有重要意义。
